tasks.short: Develop craft designs with specialized design software

steps.what: Develop the actual craft concept, material constraints and desired form from the artist's own work
inputs: Artist's actual concept and material knowledge
Existing craft design or CAD software, defined as OTHER
outputs: Artist-authored design intent and construction constraints

steps.what: Construct the craft design's repeated geometry, patterns or dimensions in the specialized software
inputs: Artist-authored form and exact constraints from s1
outputs: Editable design geometry following the artist's specified repetition and dimensions

steps.what: Refine the actual design's proportions, material expression and construction details
inputs: Editable design from s2
Actual material and craft constraints

steps.what: Check the complete final software design against artistic intent, dimensions and practical making constraints
inputs: Complete design from s3
Original intent and constraints

steps.what: Save the exact checked design version in the existing design software
inputs: Exact final design checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure native pattern, repeat and dimension features in {OTHER} craft design software for artist-specified geometry. The artist develops and refines the design and checks the complete version before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually recreating repeated elements can consume time within actual software design work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native editable pattern and constraint features can reproduce explicit geometry without generating the creative concept.
tasks.still_hard: Material expression, proportions and making feasibility require artistic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the object should express and whether the design can be made as intended.

ambition.what: Inspect an additional artist-specified pattern variant during the same design session.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specialized design software commonly supports editable repetition and dimensional constraints; these features automate explicit geometry rather than artistic intent.

assumptions: Conditional repeated-pattern design episode, not a measured baseline for every craft or software package. The artist authors all geometry constraints and concept inputs in s1; no free design brief or ready-made concept.
Native features first. Existing pattern and constraint use is baseline and earns no new saving; the s2 reduction applies only to actual repeated manual construction that configuration changes.
s2 retains feature setup, geometric inspection and exception editing; s3 retains all artistic refinement. Unsupported shapes remain manual, with no generated making or machine-control instruction.
Final design exists before s4's ordinary full check. Saving is negligible and fully retained; no separate manufacturer send, toolpath export or publication is hidden.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 35 times 30% equals 10.5, less upkeep 2 gives net 8.5.
unknowns: Actual craft software features and repeated-geometry effort
research_questions: Which repeated manual geometry can current native tools replace without adding more correction work?

already_counted.description: Actual concept development, retained geometric setup/review, artistic refinement and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain and validate reusable pattern and constraint settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete craft design checked in s4; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional repeated-geometry saving 10.5 less upkeep 2; no saving for artistic decisions or existing native automation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research craft trends, venues and customer buying patterns

steps.what: Gather actual craft-trend and venue sources and existing sales records, checking sources and capturing required research fields
inputs: Actual trend publications and venue information from their publishers
Existing shop sales records produced in normal selling work
Artist's current research question
outputs: Source-linked research records and checked sales extract with explicit periods, categories and missing fields

steps.what: Import the checked sales extract and exact artist-captured venue fields into the research workbook
inputs: Checked structured sales and venue records from s1
Explicit identifier, date and category mappings
outputs: Staged research tables with traceable source fields and unmatched entries

steps.what: Calculate exact buying-pattern counts and totals by the artist's explicit period and product categories and sort venue facts
inputs: Staged records from s2
Artist-specified categories, periods and formulas
outputs: Traceable descriptive sales tables and venue comparison, with no inferred demand forecast

steps.what: Read actual craft-trend and venue material, interpret buying patterns and develop design or marketing implications
inputs: Actual source publications and venue records
Descriptive tables and original sales evidence
outputs: Artist's source-grounded observations, uncertainties and design or marketing ideas

steps.what: Write the actual research findings and check the complete note, source links and descriptive figures
inputs: Actual observations and ideas from s4
Sources and traceable tables
outputs: Complete checked research note with limitations

steps.what: Save the exact checked research note and linked workbook version
inputs: Exact checked note and workbook from s5

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} imports and descriptive tables for checked sales data and artist-captured venue fields. The artist reads the actual trend sources, interprets the findings and writes and checks the final {DOCS} research note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual table assembly and repeated counting can take time away from reading and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, exact category mappings and formulas can reproduce descriptive comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: A sales pattern does not prove a market trend, and venue suitability depends on context.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what is distinctive and turn limited evidence into grounded creative ideas.

ambition.what: Compare a second explicitly defined product-period grouping during the same research session.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native workbook imports and formulas can assemble exact descriptive sales and venue tables, while interpreting trends requires reading and judgement.

assumptions: Representative research episode that genuinely includes manual sales and venue tables and an actual findings note; not a measured baseline or universal mix for all trend browsing.

Sales records arise from normal selling work; publishers produce source material. Artist collection, source checking, category choice and venue-field capture are fully counted in s1. Missing or unstructured facts remain manual rather than assumed to be a clean feed.
Native configuration first; existing dashboard totals and exports are baseline and earn no new saving. s2 and s3 replace only actual manual import/assembly and exact arithmetic work.
No automatic trend classification, model-only source exclusion, invented customer behaviour or causal demand forecast. All source reading and meaning-making remain in s4.
Actual note writing and complete source/figure check remain in s5. Saving takes approximately no time today and earns no saving; no marketing publication or venue booking is hidden.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 20 plus 20 equals 40, less upkeep 4 gives net 36. Generalizing to the whole task requires observing the real research mix.
unknowns: Actual sales export fields, current table automation and research-note practice
research_questions: Which descriptive comparisons are truly assembled manually rather than already supplied by native sales reports?

already_counted.description: Source collection and field capture, actual source reading and interpretation, findings writing and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain exact import mappings and descriptive category/formula definitions

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete research note and linked workbook checked in s5; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual table-assembly scenario: gross 40 minus upkeep 4; source reading, creative interpretation and actual writing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Keep research sources and creative judgement distinct
role.ambitious_version: The craft artist constructs explicit repeated geometry and research tables with less repetition while retaining artistic intent, source reading and marketing judgement.
